exact.拨回正位。板可走，空不可走。石头不变。: Flip back upright. Plates are open, gaps are closed. Stones stay shut.
exact.拨到反位。空可走，板不可走。石头不变。: Flip to the other side. Gaps are open, plates are closed. Stones stay shut.
exact.下一格不可走，迈步会受伤并停住。: The next cell is closed. Stepping wounds you and you stay put.
exact.跳过下一格，直接离开这段。: Hop the next cell and leave the stage.
exact.跳过下一格，落在可走的那一格。花 1 簧。: Hop the next cell onto an open one. Costs 1 spring.
exact.拨动让所有板变空、所有空变板。石头两边都不安全，只能跳。: A flip turns every plate into a gap and every gap into a plate. A stone is never open. Hop it.
exact.簧要留给石头，不要拿去跳普通的空。: Save springs for stones. Do not spend them hopping an ordinary gap.
exact.把本局石头在第几格、正位和反位哪一段更长写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作: Write which cell held the stone, and whether the upright or flipped run was longer, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
